description: Express response sinks check the written body, URL or header value only. Fluent chains (res.status(n).send) classify by their final method, and taint on the res object itself (res.locals, a fetch Response named res) is not a payload.

expected.notes: the body of res.set(...).send(q) is the send payload
the chain head res.set only receives constant header arguments; q reaches send, not a header
a tainted res.locals field does not make res.json({ ok: true }) or res.redirect('/home') carry request data
zero-arg res.json() on a fetch Response has no payload
res.status(code).json() writes no body; the status argument is not a payload
a response call without a body argument is not a sink
